item.skt: dz+nyA na tsak+Shu sA d+ha na nA ma
item.coloph: spyan lnga bsgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon dus zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /dus zhabs kyis thugs rje chen po la sogs pa rig gsum mgon po la gsan no/ des ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro suR+Ya d+harma la/ des rat+na shrI b+ha dra la/ des shAkya shrI b+ha dra la/ des rgya gar shar phyogs dzA ga d+ha la'i paN+Di ta ma hA bi b+hu ti tsan dras sgra rang 'gyur du mdzad nas bsgyur ba'o
